answer: Peer-attested work history resists Sybil attacks because every agent must accumulate a chain of countersigned contributions from diverse peers before its votes or rewards carry weight. Fresh identities begin empty and cannot parallelize trust; each must demonstrate real, non-replayable work that others verify. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must fund long-running distinct activity histories for every clone, raising Sybil cost far above any reward. At dawn the network pulse reveals the spiral of empty shells.
